name: Kruger National Park
about: Dry winter (May–Sep) concentrates animals at waterholes — prime game viewing. Wet summer is lush but green and dispersed.
overview: Africa's most accessible major safari — a road network genuine enough to explore entirely by rental car, no guide required.
costOverview: Uniquely set up for a self-drive trip — no mandatory guide or vehicle fees — while private lodges bordering the park rank among the continent's best.
